caption:
Pour your heart out on Sunday, a different you by Monday? Split praise sounds like noise. (Amos 5:23 devotional)

Praise without a life to back it becomes, to God, only noise. You don't need two selves; one honest self is enough.

📌 Save this for your quiet time
💬 Is there a gap between the me who worships and the me who lives?
